title: "F-SNARK — Witness-succinct UC NIZK"
status: "Canonical"

*F-SNARK* (Witness-succinct UC NIZK) is part of *Layer 4: Commitments and Proofs* in the UC functionality encyclopedia. Status: a canonical, well-established UC functionality.

A 2024 result that some deployed zkSNARKs are unconditionally UC-secure in the random oracle model strengthens this functionality's realizability picture.

*References:*

- Ganesh et al. *Witness-succinct universally-composable SNARKs*. In Advances in Cryptology – EUROCRYPT 2023, Part II, volume 14005 of LNCS, pages 315–346, 2023.
- Chiesa and Fenzi. *zkSNARKs in the ROM with unconditional UC-security*. In 22nd Theory of Cryptography Conference (TCC), Part I, volume 15364 of LNCS, 2024.
- Kosba et al. *C0C0: A framework for building composable zero-knowledge proofs*. Cryptology ePrint Archive, Paper 2015/1093, 2015. (citation not independently verified)
